resources.purpose: Reusable nine-slice frame for hand, action choices and journals
resources.canvas: Full original canvas, alpha; one asset per call
resources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production UI asset for DropInn: a blank handmade parchment game-card FRAME, front-on, upright, almost square (4:5 silhouette) centered on an actual transparent alpha background. This is the reusable border for action cards and needs to work at 60 pixels. Chunky true black slightly jagged stair-stepped outlines, primitive old Windows MS Paint mouse doodle, clumsy uneven silhouette, flat bucket fills, cream paper #fff4d6, ochre edge #bd9850, two broad corner folds. One simple slightly off-kilter stitched corner. Large EMPTY uniform pale cream center covers at least 75% of the shape, no icons or symbols in center, no words, no letters. Thin perimeter around the blank center, no ornate flourishes. Thick black outlines only at perimeter. Transparent margin 5% around complete unclipped card. Absolutely no gradients, no grain, no texture, no realistic shadows, no glowing light, no smooth vector elegance, no extra objects. Match a lovingly awkward MS Paint fantasy tabletop game. Asset only, not a screenshot or mockup.
